title: GPT-6 Astra Solves a WWI German Radio Cipher
summary: An AI system called GPT-6 Astra demonstrates its ability to decrypt a World War I German military radio cipher, showcasing advanced pattern recognition and cryptanalysis capabilities through a historical cryptography challenge.
problem_solved: Demonstrates how modern AI can tackle historical encryption challenges that stumped military intelligence a century ago.
why_valuable: Combines AI capabilities with historical education, showing practical applications of LLMs in security research while making WWI cryptography accessible and engaging.
